# ForgeOps Documentation

> AI agents should consult [Docs for Agents](https://developer.pingidentity.com/build-with-ai/docs-for-agents.md)
> for guidance on navigating Ping Identity documentation.

## Forgeops 2026.3

- [<code>am</code> and <code>idm</code> images](https://docs.pingidentity.com/forgeops/2026.3/customize/fr-data.md): Manage PingAM and PingIDM static and dynamic configuration, exports, and configuration profiles in ForgeOps
- [<code>am</code> image](https://docs.pingidentity.com/forgeops/2026.3/customize/am.md): Customize PingAM configuration profiles, build BusyBox images, and redeploy PingAM in ForgeOps
- [<code>ds</code> image](https://docs.pingidentity.com/forgeops/2026.3/customize/ds.md): Customize PingDS LDAP configuration, schema, and setup scripts, then build and redeploy a custom Docker image in ForgeOps
- [<code>forgeops</code> repository feature evolution](https://docs.pingidentity.com/forgeops/2026.3/rn/evolution.md): Track ForgeOps releases including new features, deprecation, and removals
- [<code>idm</code> image](https://docs.pingidentity.com/forgeops/2026.3/customize/idm.md): Customize PingIDM configuration profiles, build BusyBox images, and redeploy PingIDM in ForgeOps
- [<code>kubectl</code> shell autocompletion](https://docs.pingidentity.com/forgeops/2026.3/troubleshoot/tab-completion.md): Enable kubectl shell autocompletion in Bash or Zsh
- [<span class="command">dsbackup</span> utility](https://docs.pingidentity.com/forgeops/2026.3/backup/dsbackup.md): Configure DS backups and restores in ForgeOps with the dsbackup utility, cloud storage, scheduled backups, and disaster recovery
- [<span class="command">forgeops</span> command reference](https://docs.pingidentity.com/forgeops/2026.3/reference/forgeops-cmd-ref.md): Use the `forgeops` command-line tool reference for generating overlays, managing Helm values, deploying components, and building Docker images
- [About custom images](https://docs.pingidentity.com/forgeops/2026.3/customize/custom-images.md): Build custom Docker images for Ping Advanced Identity Software products configuration in development and production
- [About ForgeOps benchmarking](https://docs.pingidentity.com/forgeops/2026.3/reference/benchmark/intro.md): Understand sample ForgeOps benchmarking and performance measuring
- [About ForgeOps deployment monitoring](https://docs.pingidentity.com/forgeops/2026.3/prepare/monitoring/monitoring-intro.md): Install and customize Prometheus, Grafana, and Alertmanager to monitor ForgeOps deployments
- [About property value substitution](https://docs.pingidentity.com/forgeops/2026.3/customize/value-substitution.md): Configure AM and IDM property value substitution using configuration expressions for environment-specific deployment settings
- [Access restriction by IP address](https://docs.pingidentity.com/forgeops/2026.3/prepare/security/restrict-access-ip-address.md): Restrict ForgeOps ingress access to worker nodes from specified IP addresses with a CIDR block
- [Additional setup](https://docs.pingidentity.com/forgeops/2026.3/customize/setup.md): Set up ForgeOps for custom Docker images, including single-instance deployments, registries, repositories, and deployment environments
- [Alerts](https://docs.pingidentity.com/forgeops/2026.3/prepare/monitoring/alerts.md): Configure Prometheus alerts for ForgeOps deployments with Alertmanager and initial rules
- [Articles in the <code>forgeops</code> repository](https://docs.pingidentity.com/forgeops/2026.3/reference/how-tos.md): The how-to articles on the `forgeops` GitHub repository describe usage of ForgeOps artifacts in special cases not covered in the ForgeOps documentation
- [Assess your skill level](https://docs.pingidentity.com/forgeops/2026.3/start/start-here-skills.md): Assess skills required for deploying ForgeOps on Kubernetes

- [Base Docker images](https://docs.pingidentity.com/forgeops/2026.3/reference/base-docker-images.md): Build custom Docker images from PingAM, PingIDM, PingDS, and PingGateway base images for ForgeOps deployments in production environments
